messages:
IncBot: ALERT: multiple serving-runtime pods reporting OOM + CUDA illegal memory access on gpu-pool-europe-1. Auto-mitigation attempted (evict + fallback) — see /incidents/5067890123 for details. @oncall please ack :rotating_light:
Alex Chen: acked. I'm oncall. seeing a cascade: containers crash -> node flaps -> immediate pod restarts. stack shows cudaIllegalAccess at runtime::device_mem_map()
Maya Patel: reported customer error rates + latencies spiking for embeddings endpoints in eu-west. Queueing requests backed up. Customers in trial experiencing ~30% errors.
Jamal Rivera: logs from node gpu-12: 
```
[I] runtime: starting inference loop
[E] CUDA illegal memory access at 0x7f8b3c45f000
[E] backtrace: runtime.cpp:453 kernel_launcher.cu:78 nvml: gpu0: ECC? no
[W] process terminated with signal 11
```
Priya Singh: can we confirm if this coincided with the nightly model reload window?
Alex Chen: yes reloads kicked ~5067890110, but errors persist on nodes that did NOT reload. suggests not model binary bug only.
Sasha R.: I'm seeing correlated kernel oops on host logs: 
```
[kernel] cpu:6 calling error handler
[kernel] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[kernel] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: GPU instance crashed, mm fault
```
Alex Chen: hypothesis: a race in GPU page table handling under heavy eviction pressure triggers misaligned device address accesses -> CUDA illegal memory access in clients. Could be kernel driver/hypervisor interaction.
Maya Patel: impact summary for CS: 12 customers affected intermittently, 3 with >10% request failures (ids: C-1220, C-1819, C-2034). Sending initial customer note now.
Customer Support Bot: Draft sent to affected customers; includes link to status page and temporary mitigation guidance (retry/backoff).
Jamal Rivera: mitigation plan I: cordon gpu-12,gpu-13; migrate critical pods to other pools; increase replica counts for embeddings to absorb errors; disable scheduled model reloads until patch.
Priya Singh: drill: do we have a safe rollback of the serving-runtime image? Last known-good tag: rwinf/serve:2026-04-11-stable.
Alex Chen: yes. I propose: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) drain pods with graceful timeout 60s 3) rollback any recent runtime rollouts on eu-west pool -> rwinf/serve:2026-04-11-stable 4) disable reloads 5) monitor 6) engage kernel/driver upstream if kernel oops persist.
Sasha R.: added kernel dump + nv-hostengine logs to /var/log/diag/5067890123-dumps.tar.gz. Uploading to SRE bucket now.
Maya Patel: preparing customer update: we will provide ETA in 30m. asking Product to approve wording.
Priya Singh: @Alex can you run the rollback on canary first (eu-west-canary) and post results?
Alex Chen: running canary rollback now -> executing:
```
kubectl -n prod set image ds/serve rwinf/serve:2026-04-11-stable --record
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
Alex Chen: canary pods restarted, initial checks: no cuda errors in new pods for 2m, latency nominal. Prometheus shows CPU/GPU utilization stable.
Jamal Rivera: good. I'll start rolling affected pool with conservative parallelism=1 and 10m pause between pods. also enabling resume of autoscaler to move background load.
IncBot: NOTE: automated fallback to cpu-variant model occurred for 48 requests in the last 10m. Costly but prevented more client errors.
Maya Patel: internal note: ops will prepare an RCA ticket; legal asked for incident timeline if customer requests GDPR/contract info.
Sasha R.: kernel oops count decreased after cordon/rollback. Not seeing new NVRM Xids on rolled nodes. Dump analysis in progress.
Alex Chen: continuing rollout. keep all non-essential reloads off. tagging eng-runtime and kernel team for follow-up: @eng-runtime @eng-ops.
Priya Singh: handoff to next oncall at 5067890180 — @Maya you're up. I'll brief you in 2m.
Maya Patel: thanks. acked. updating status page: "Partial degradation in eu-west for embeddings; mitigation in progress; operations rolling back runtime and cordoning affected nodes." :white_check_mark:
Customer Support Bot: Notifying customers of mitigation steps and expected follow-up.
Jamal Rivera: next steps: if kernel oops reappear after rollback -> escalate to Nvidia kernel drivers & cloud infra to inspect host firmware. Also collect perf traces (nsys) from non-rolled nodes for comparison.
Alex Chen: logging final action items in incident tracker: cordon list, rollback tag, dump locations, customer list, timeline. Moving to monitoring mode.
Maya Patel: last check: error rate trending down from 18% -> 2% in 10m. continuing watch.
IncBot: INCIDENT:5067890123 status=mitigated; assigned_to=Maya Patel; severity=high; timeline_url=/incidents/5067890123/timeline
Maya Patel: handing off full incident to next shift. closing this slack thread for now. please reopen if errors spike. :handshake:
